legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera follows the rainwater pouring from the big stone spout, glides back from the courtyard through the window into the warm kitchen of the same house, and settles close on a clear glass being filled with clean water at the brass tap, rain streaming down the window behind.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. From the glass at the kitchen tap the camera turns and glides out through the open door as the rain clears, into the vegetable garden in warm golden light, past the basket on the path, homes with solar roofs beyond.
